releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.8.0 (Flagship 9 Next-Gen AI Pro Suite)
changelog:
🚀 Major Flagship Release v10.8.0 — Complete 9 Next-Gen AI Pro Suite:
• Pro Feature 1: Document Health & Quality Doctor — Real-time DPI, blur, skew & glare diagnostic scan with 1-tap auto-cure.
• Pro Feature 2: NotebookLM Document AI Chat — Multi-page grounded reasoning with interactive page citations.
• Pro Feature 3: Smart Auto-Vault & Expiry Watchdog — Automatic 6-category document tagging & calendar renewal reminders.
• Pro Feature 4: Smart Expense & GST Receipt Auditor — Spatial invoice extraction & CA-ready Excel (.xlsx) export.
• Pro Feature 5: Hands-Free Book Scanner — Page-turn optical flow & acoustic voice shutter with spine shadow removal.
• Pro Feature 6: Hardware Biometric Vault & Decoy PIN — AES-256-GCM zero-knowledge encryption with duress decoy mode.
• Pro Feature 7: Magic Eraser 2.0 — AI object removal & deep inpainting with strict printed black toner protection.
• Pro Feature 8: Offline Secure OCR 2.0 — Multi-lingual Hindi/English Ctrl+F live word search & instant tap-to-copy.
• Pro Feature 9: Auto-Merge & Smart Batch Compressor — Combine up to 20 documents to exact Govt KB limits (SSC, UPSC, NTA).
